text.p: Vietnam said on Monday it had put to death a man convicted of murder, marking the latest in a series of recent reported executions.
The Lao Dong (Labour) newspaper said Pham Van Manh, born in 1972, had attacked a colleague with a knife during an argument last year in a town near Hanoi.
He then ran amok killing a passer-by, the report said. His execution took place on October 2.
Executions in Vietnam are carried out by firing squad and normally go unreported. However, details of several have appeared in the country's state-controlled media in recent weeks.
